# We Summit Mountains

> Salesforce consulting and technology services company based in Dallas, TX. We specialize in Salesforce implementation, AI consulting, system integrations, and fractional CTO services.

## Services

- **Salesforce Implementation:** End-to-end deployment of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Monthly fractional implementation (Mountain Guide Services).
- **AI Consulting & Implementation:** On-premise and cloud-based AI — agentic workflows, data analysis, chatbots with tools, document processing. Agentforce, Einstein AI, n8n, RAG systems, vector databases.
- **System Integration Services:** Planning, implementing, and executing integrated solutions connecting Salesforce with ERP, marketing automation, and custom applications.
- **Fractional CTO Services:** Long-term strategic partnership — discover technical constraints, needs, and growth potential. Plan, execute, and report on implementation success across your business.

## Team

All team members are Salesforce Certified and US-based.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2023
- Location: Dallas, Texas, USA
- Specialization: Salesforce ecosystem, AI implementation, cloud CRM
- Combined team experience: 14+ years in Salesforce
- 100% US-based team
